The first 1.5.0 beta moves Flytower's core onto native parts. The **Rust** agent is now the only system helper: the Bun one is gone, so `bun` in `/etc/flytower/agent` no longer does anything, and the Native update channel is retired (boxes on it move to the channel of the release they run, with a notice). The agent now starts, stops and follows servers through systemd over D-Bus, and the panel follows consoles, crashes, joins and server states as live streams from the agent instead of reading log files on a timer.

Every server on a box can now share one address. Turn on **One address for every server** under **System, Addresses** and Flytower runs a small hostname router on port 25565 that sends each player to the server whose address they typed, and answers for servers that are stopped or starting. Fabric servers get the `flytower-proxy` mod and Paper servers get their proxy setting, so they still see players' real addresses and IP bans keep working. A server's **World** tab can also **Trim unused chunks**: preview what would go, see it shaded on the web map, protect areas you care about, then trim to make the world, its backups and its map smaller.

Because the agent now talks to systemd over D-Bus, the box needs the `dbus` package. Most Ubuntu and Debian servers already have it; if yours doesn't, run `sudo apt install dbus` before or after updating. This is a beta, so please try it on a test server first, and keep a backup before trimming a world you care about. Two parts haven't yet run outside our test rigs: systemd over D-Bus on a real box, and the `flytower-proxy` mod on a real Fabric server. Testing notes are in [testing-1.5.0.md](https://github.com/teamflytower/flytower/blob/v1.5.0-beta.1/docs/testing/testing-1.5.0.md).
